claim: Patchline ships a localization and accessibility conformance covering twenty languages with parity gates. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the twenty languages claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make localization-accessibility-parity-gate`.
